title: Official channel entry
$comment: Authoritative institutional channels the protocol links OUT to (spec §7.1). Not publishers; never validated for conformance.

authority_lang.description: BCP-47 tag for the language the authority's name is written in. An institution's legal name is not translated, so a consumer rendering it inside a document in another language needs to mark it — a screen reader that reads 'Unidad Nacional para la Gestion del Riesgo de Desastres' with English phonemes is unintelligible. Required rather than defaulted: the registry is designed to hold sources from any country, and there is no language that is the right guess for all of them.

notes.description: Free-text context, written natively in both languages. Rendered verbatim on the registry pages, which are published in both — a note in one language only would leave half the readers with a blank field where the caveat should be.
